# cpanel_subdomain (Data Source)

Looks up a cPanel web subdomain and its document root.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "cpanel_subdomain" "app" {
  domain = "app.example.com"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `domain` (String) The complete subdomain name.

### Read-Only

- `document_root` (String) The document root relative to the cPanel account home.
- `root_domain` (String) The existing main or addon domain that owns the subdomain.
- `subdomain` (String) The subdomain portion before the root domain.
